reference.configuration: Furious carrier, reference after the small starboard island was added in 1939. The long upper flight deck, lower forward flying-off deck and paired lifts identify the converted carrier. This is explicitly a later recognition fit, not the islandless 1925 appearance or the original 18-inch-gun cruiser.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
